Why we roast small.

Foundry started as one roaster in a lock-up unit. We kept it that way on purpose — it's the only way to taste every batch before it goes out the door.

Every bag is dated, every pour is timed, and every coffee is served the way the roaster intended it to be.

Find us in town.

Tucked just off the main strip, a short walk from the town centre. Street parking nearby, with a regular bus route close by.

Questions we get asked.

Do you offer oat or plant milk?+
Yes — oat, almond, soy and coconut are all available on any milk-based drink for a small extra charge.
Do you cater for allergies or dietary needs?+
Yes — just let us know at the counter. Full allergen information is available on request, and several sandwiches and pastries are vegetarian.
Can I buy your beans to take home?+
Absolutely — bags of whatever we're currently roasting are available at the counter, ground or whole bean.
Is there anywhere to sit and work?+
A few tables inside with plugs nearby, though we're a small spot so it can get busy mid-morning.
